commit.subject: hooks: implement the matrix v2 refusal rows
commit.body:
Refuse session dispatches of ladder-owned jobs, path-form unittest
commands, and path-form implement scopes. Keep the allowed direct jobs
as documented module data, honor only an unscoped open grant for a
driver-job escape, recognize launcher commands only in command position,
and cover unresolved inputs and root-level Python writes.
